sources.title: Senator Pauline Hanson — Parliamentarian profile
sources.note: Senator for QLD; Leader of the Federal Parliamentary Pauline Hanson's One Nation from 2.7.2016 (recorded as Leader of One Nation from 28.1.2026 after the party's rebranding); elected to the Senate 2016, re-elected 2022.

sources.title: Senate composition
sources.note: Records four One Nation senators in the 48th Parliament.

notes: First elected to the House of Representatives for Oxley in 1996; elected to the Senate in 2016. APH records the party as One Nation from 28 January 2026 following its rebranding from Pauline Hanson's One Nation.

sources.title: Senator Malcolm Roberts — Parliamentarian profile
sources.note: Senator for QLD, One Nation; elected 2016 (election ruled void 27.10.2017), elected 2019, re-elected 2025; no current party office recorded.

sources.title: Senator Malcolm Roberts — personal website
sources.note: Listed on APH as personal website; posts dated 30 September 2026.

notes: Elected in 2016; that election was ruled void by the High Court in October 2017; elected again in 2019 and re-elected in 2025.

positions.title: Member, House Standing Committee on Primary Industries

sources.title: Mr David Farley MP — Parliamentarian profile
sources.note: Member for Farrer, One Nation; elected at the 2026 by-election vice the Hon S Ley (resigned); House Standing Committee on Primary Industries from 24.6.2026.

sources.title: 2026 Farrer by-election — division results
sources.note: Final results: Farley (One Nation) elected with 57.55 per cent of the two-candidate-preferred vote.

sources.title: Federal politics live, 2 June 2026
sources.note: Reports Farley taking his seat in the House of Representatives.

notes: Elected at the Farrer by-election held on 9 May 2026, the first One Nation candidate elected to the House of Representatives. No official website is listed on APH.
